FN-NUMH8T8-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 305
Committee: County and Municipal Government Sponsor: Representative Marcus Paramore
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 03/26/2024
House Bill 305 as introduced could increase the obligations of certain municipal gas districts,
paid from district funds, by an estimated minimum of $2,250 per meeting beginning in Fiscal
Year 2025.
Page 1
